d: Long, wavy ash-blonde hair with center-parted bangs is adorned by two large cobalt blue bows. The face is that of a young teenager with bright cobalt blue eyes and a cheerful expression. A slender build is dressed in a white and light blue kimono-style wrap with wide sleeves, paired with a dark navy blue hakama skirt featuring small light blue floral patterns and a gold waistband. The outfit is complemented by tan lace-up boots, while the figure is flanked by mechanical grey naval artillery gear including gun turrets and ship masts.
